headword: マイクロプラスチック
reading: まいくろぷらすちっく

definitions.explanation: Tiny fragments of plastic, generally less than 5 mm, found in oceans, rivers, food, and even the human body. A major environmental and public health concern.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}でマイクロプラスチックが{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: Microplastics were found in the ocean.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}の{体|からだ}からもマイクロプラスチックが{検出|けんしゅつ}されている。
examples.english: Microplastics have also been detected in the bodies of fish.

examples.japanese: マイクロプラスチック{汚染|おせん}を{減|へ}らすために、レジ{袋|ぶくろ}が{有料化|ゆうりょうか}された。
examples.english: Plastic bags were made paid for in order to reduce microplastic pollution.

notes:
Loanword from English. Refers to plastic particles smaller than about 5 millimeters; an environmental term that appears constantly in news coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マイクロプラスチック{汚染|おせん}: microplastic pollution
- マイクロプラスチック{問題|もんだい}: the microplastics problem
- {海洋|かいよう}マイクロプラスチック: marine microplastics
- マイクロプラスチックを{減|へ}らす: to reduce microplastics

RELATED WORDS:
- ナノプラスチック: nanoplastics (even smaller, sub-micrometer)
- プラスチックごみ: plastic waste (broader, includes large items)
